modules.title: Ubuntu Leadership Philosophy
modules.description: Leadership development rooted in the African Ubuntu philosophy — 'I am because we are' — integrating collective wisdom with modern management practices.
learningObjectives: Apply Ubuntu principles to team leadership and decision-making
Balance collective and individual accountability in African workplaces
Build consensus through inclusive dialogue practices
Leverage African oral tradition in organizational storytelling

modules.title: South African Labour Law Compliance
modules.description: Comprehensive South African employment compliance covering the Labour Relations Act, Basic Conditions of Employment Act, Employment Equity Act, and BBBEE.
learningObjectives: Apply key provisions of South African labour legislation
Manage disciplinary and grievance processes per LRA
Meet Employment Equity Act reporting obligations
Understand BBBEE scorecard requirements
modules.audience: HR teams and managers in South Africa

modules.title: Doing Business in Nigeria
modules.description: Business culture, relationship-building, regulatory navigation, and market entry insights for professionals operating in Nigeria's dynamic economy.
learningObjectives: Navigate Nigerian business culture and relationship norms
Understand the regulatory and informal business environment
Build effective networks across Nigeria's diverse ethnic groups
Manage business risk in a high-opportunity, high-complexity market

modules.title: East African Community Business
modules.description: Business and cultural training for operating across the East African Community — Kenya, Tanzania, Uganda, Rwanda, and Burundi.
learningObjectives: Understand EAC common market and regulatory harmonization
Navigate cultural differences across East African nations
Build relationships using Swahili business phrases
Adapt business practices to each country's context

modules.title: Africa Anti-Corruption & Governance
modules.description: Anti-bribery and corruption compliance for African operations, covering national laws, AU anti-corruption frameworks, and high-risk sector practices.
learningObjectives: Identify bribery and corruption risks specific to African markets
Apply AU Convention on Preventing and Combating Corruption principles
Manage facilitation payments and agent relationships
Report corruption concerns safely

modules.title: Mobile Money & Fintech in Africa
modules.description: Understanding Africa's mobile money revolution and fintech ecosystem — M-Pesa, MTN Mobile Money, and how financial inclusion drives economic opportunity.
learningObjectives: Understand the mobile money ecosystem in Sub-Saharan Africa
Leverage mobile financial platforms in business operations
Apply AML/KYC in mobile money contexts
Identify fintech innovation opportunities in African markets
modules.audience: Finance, technology, and business development teams

modules.title: French West Africa Business Culture
modules.description: Cultural intelligence for doing business in Francophone West Africa — Côte d'Ivoire, Senegal, Cameroon, Mali, and Burkina Faso.
learningObjectives: Navigate French colonial influence on West African business culture
Build relationships with French-speaking West African stakeholders
Understand OHADA legal system for business operations
Adapt communication to Francophone African context
modules.audience: Professionals engaging with Francophone West Africa

modules.title: Health & Safety in African Operations
modules.description: Workplace health and safety training adapted for African operating environments, including field operations, construction, and high-risk industries.
learningObjectives: Apply health and safety standards in challenging African operating environments
Manage tropical disease and travel health risks
Implement safety protocols in remote and field operations
Address mental health challenges in isolated work locations
modules.audience: All employees in African operations, especially field staff

modules.title: Gender Equity & Women in African Leadership
modules.description: Advancing gender equity in African workplaces, addressing patriarchal norms, women's economic empowerment, and creating inclusive leadership pipelines.
learningObjectives: Understand barriers to women's advancement in African workplaces
Apply gender lens to recruitment, promotion, and pay equity
Create mentoring and sponsorship programs for women leaders
Engage male allies in gender equity efforts
modules.audience: All employees; especially managers and HR

modules.title: Egypt Business Culture & Arabic Essentials
modules.description: Business culture and basic Arabic for professionals engaging with Egypt's large and strategically important North African economy.
learningObjectives: Navigate Egyptian business hierarchy and relationship norms
Use basic business Arabic phrases and greetings
Understand the role of personal connections (wasta) in Egyptian business
Adapt to Egyptian negotiation and decision-making styles

modules.title: Africa Digital Skills Bootcamp
modules.description: Building foundational digital skills to support Africa's rapidly growing digital economy — cloud tools, digital collaboration, and data literacy.
learningObjectives: Use cloud-based productivity tools effectively
Apply data literacy skills for business decision-making
Navigate digital collaboration in low-bandwidth environments
Build digital content for African audiences

modules.title: Ghana & West Africa Business
modules.description: Business insights for Ghana and anglophone West Africa, covering relationship culture, chieftaincy protocols, and Ghana's growing economic significance.
learningObjectives: Understand Ghanaian business relationship norms and hierarchy
Navigate chieftaincy and traditional authority in business contexts
Engage with Ghana's thriving entrepreneurial ecosystem
Build trust with West African partners and clients
modules.audience: Professionals engaging with Ghana and West Africa

modules.title: Rwanda's Vision 2050 & Business Opportunity
modules.description: Understanding Rwanda's remarkable development trajectory, Vision 2050 objectives, and the business opportunities in Africa's fastest-reforming economy.
learningObjectives: Understand Rwanda's Vision 2050 strategic objectives
Identify business opportunities in Rwanda's priority sectors
Navigate Rwanda's ease-of-doing-business environment
Understand Rwanda's regional hub strategy in East Africa

modules.title: Sustainable Development & AfCFTA
modules.description: Africa Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) business implications and sustainable development opportunities across the African continent.
learningObjectives: Understand AfCFTA trade rules and tariff elimination schedules
Identify cross-border business opportunities under AfCFTA
Navigate rules of origin requirements
Align operations with AU Agenda 2063 sustainability goals
modules.audience: Trade, supply chain, and business development teams

modules.title: POPIA Data Protection (South Africa)
modules.description: Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) compliance training for South African operations, covering the eight conditions for lawful processing.
learningObjectives: Apply POPIA's eight conditions for lawful processing
Handle data subject requests within prescribed timeframes
Manage Information Officers' responsibilities
Report data breaches to the Information Regulator
